scope: The Mosque of the Andalusians in Fez as documented in April 2016. Model the named mosque envelope, open courtyard and fountain, prayer hall roofscape, minaret and monumental northern entrance. Adjacent neighborhood buildings are outside the scope.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The authors’ field study identifies seven transverse prayer-hall naves, a partly articulated axial roof, the minaret centered in the irregular east courtyard gallery, an open court with a central fountain, and a stepped monumental northern portal crowned by projecting carpentry.
IRCICA identifies the mosque as the historic congregational mosque of Fez’s Andalusian quarter.
